procedure_steps.instruction: Dissolve 2 g acetanilide in 2 mL glacial acetic acid in a 100 mL beaker; add 4 mL concentrated sulphuric acid gradually with stirring and cool to 0-5 degrees C.
procedure_steps.observation: A hot clear solution forms before chilling.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.
